cases.name: ADR-0330 §6 (X1): opened again by ExSheet, a Formula that reads the Excel Table is refused by name, until ExSheet reads Excel Tables
cases.note: A Workbook with two Linked Tables, both answered, and Formulas on two Sheets that read them.

refused.message: Sheet 'Trades', cell A1 (=SUM(Positions[PV])): The Formula reads an Excel Table, which ExSheet does not read.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6 (X1): with no Formula reading it, the table's worksheet opens again as a Sheet of its cells, not as a Linked Table, and the report says so

notCarried.description: 'Positions' has Excel Tables; their cells are carried, the Tables are not.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: the write is refused by name while a Linked Table has not answered

refused.message: Sheet 'Positions': The Linked Table 'Positions' has not answered: it holds no rows yet, or its last snapshot was refused, and every Formula that reads it shows #GETTING_DATA. Its rows are written as they stand, and it has none to write.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6, ADR-0049: a Linked Table whose last snapshot was refused for a repeated key waits again, and is refused as one that has not answered

refused.message: Sheet 'Positions': The Linked Table 'Positions' has not answered: it holds no rows yet, or its last snapshot was refused, and every Formula that reads it shows #GETTING_DATA. Its rows are written as they stand, and it has none to write.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: a Linked Table whose name is already a Sheet's, in any case, is refused by name

refused.message: Sheet 'Positions': The Linked Table 'Positions' is written on a worksheet of its name, and the Sheet 'positions' already has it.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: a Linked Table whose name a worksheet cannot have is refused by name: the worksheet is named after it: A_name_of_thirty_two_characters_

refused.message: Sheet 'A_name_of_thirty_two_characters_': The Linked Table 'A_name_of_thirty_two_characters_' is written on a worksheet of its name, and a worksheet cannot have it: A Sheet's name is at most 31 characters.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: a Linked Table whose name a worksheet cannot have is refused by name: the worksheet is named after it: \Positions

refused.message: Sheet '\Positions': The Linked Table '\Positions' is written on a worksheet of its name, and a worksheet cannot have it: A Sheet's name cannot contain any of : \ / ? * [ ].

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: a Linked Table whose name a worksheet cannot have is refused by name: the worksheet is named after it: History

refused.message: Sheet 'History': The Linked Table 'History' is written on a worksheet of its name, and a worksheet cannot have it: 'History' is a name Excel reserves.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: a Linked Table's name the engine takes and Excel gives no Table (A01 reads as the cell A1) is refused by name, not thrown as an argument

refused.message: Sheet 'A01': The Linked Table 'A01' is written as an Excel Table of its name, and Excel gives a Table no such name: it reads as a cell's address, or holds a character a Table's name does not.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6 (spine rule 1): a Linked Table's name read as a name of its own is #NAME? in ExSheet, and Excel would read the table written: refused by name

refused.message: Sheet 'Sheet1', cell B2 (=SUM(Positions)): The Formula reads a Linked Table's name as a name of its own, which ExSheet shows as #NAME? and Excel would read as the Excel Table written.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6 (spine rule 1): a Linked Table of no rows is refused: an Excel Table holds one empty row, and its Formulas would answer otherwise

refused.message: Sheet 'Positions': The Linked Table 'Positions' holds no rows, and an Excel Table holds at least one: written with one empty row, its Formulas would answer otherwise in Excel (ROWS gives 1, COUNTBLANK 1, the column itself 0 where ExSheet shows #VALUE!).

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6, §9: a Linked Table's cells, its header's included, count toward MaxCells
cases.note: A Workbook with two Linked Tables, both answered, and Formulas on two Sheets that read them.

steps.note: 5 Formula cells on the Sheets; 4 + 10 for Positions, a blank in each of two rows; 2 + 2 for Rates.

refused.message: Sheet 'Rates': The workbook would write more than the 22 elements it may (XlsxSaveOptions.MaxCells, which counts the cells written and each row a row format writes; by default the cells a file is read with): the Linked Table 'Rates' writes 1 rows of 2 columns under its header.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: text in a Linked Table a cell of Excel cannot hold is refused by name, naming the table, the column and the row

refused.message: Sheet 'Notes', cell B3: The Linked Table 'Notes' holds, in its column 'Note', row 2, text 32,768 characters long, and a cell of Excel holds at most 32,767.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: a structured reference to a table or column no Linked Table declares has no Excel Table to read, and is refused by name: =SUM(Positions[Delta])

refused.message: Sheet 'Sheet1', cell C3 (=SUM(Positions[Delta])): The Formula reads, by a structured reference, a Linked Table or a column the Workbook does not declare; the file would hold no Excel Table of it for Excel to read.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §6: a structured reference to a table or column no Linked Table declares has no Excel Table to read, and is refused by name: =SUM(Trades[PV])

refused.message: Sheet 'Sheet1', cell C3 (=SUM(Trades[PV])): The Formula reads, by a structured reference, a Linked Table or a column the Workbook does not declare; the file would hold no Excel Table of it for Excel to read.
